special_provisions.text_zh: 1）除特殊情况外，船舶应当使用定线制水域航行，按照《中华人民共和国海事局关于在全国主要水域实施“一次性船位报告” 便利化措施的通告》要求报告。
special_provisions.text_en: 3.1 Except in special circumstances, vessels shall navigate in waters subject to the planned ship's routeing system and report in accordance with the requirements of The Notice of the Maritime Safety Administration of the People's Republic of China on the Implementation of the “One-off Vessel Position Report” Facilitation Measures in Major National Waters.

special_provisions.text_zh: 2）在定线制水域航行的船舶，不免除其遵守《1972 年国际海上避碰规则》所规定的各项责任和义务。
special_provisions.text_en: 3.2 Vessels navigating in ship's routeing system are not exempt from complying with the responsibilities and obligations stipulated in The International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea, 1972.

special_provisions.text_zh:
3）在定线制水域航行的船舶，应当遵守下列规定：
（1）在甚高频（VHF）16 频道守听。
（2）尽可能避免穿越通航分道，如需穿越时，应当提前向周围船舶通报本船动态，在确认没有顺通航分道航行的船舶接近的情况下方可穿越，并尽可能以与分道船舶总流向成直角方向穿越。
（3）如需从通航分道的一侧驶进或驶出时，应当与该通航分道的船舶总流向形成尽可能小的角度。
（4）追越时，应当提前征得被追越船同意，追越应当不致与其他船舶形成紧迫局面。
（5）在警戒区航行及驶入和驶出警戒区时应当特别谨慎航行，并运用良好的船艺。
special_provisions.text_en:
3.3 Vessels navigating in ship's routeing system shall comply with the following provisions:
(1) Keep a listening watch on VHF Channel 16.
(2) Shall, so far as practicable, avoid crossing the traffic lanes. If the crossing is unavoidable, the vessel shall notify surrounding vessels of its movements in advance and may cross only after confirming that no vessel is approaching along the traffic lanes. The crossing shall be made at an angle as close to perpendicular as possible to the general direction of traffic flow in the traffic lanes.
(3) When joining or leaving a traffic lane from either side of the lane, vessels shall do so at as small an angle to the general direction of traffic flow as practicable.
(4) When overtaking, the consent shall be obtained from the vessel being overtaken, and the overtaking manoeuvring operation shall not result in a close-quarters situation with other vessels.
(5) Vessels shall exercise particular caution and keep good seamanship when navigating within the precautionary areas, as well as when entering or exiting them.

special_provisions.text_zh: 4）不得在定线制及其端部锚泊或从事捕捞、养殖等碍航活动。
special_provisions.text_en: 3.4 Anchoring or engaging in fishing, aquaculture, or other activities that obstruct navigation is prohibited in the waters of the ship's routeing system and its terminations.

special_provisions.text_zh: 5）船舶违反定线制规定，由海事管理机构依照有关法律、行政法规的规定处理。
special_provisions.text_en: 3.5 Vessels that violate the regulations of the ship's routeing system shall be penalised by the Maritime Administration Authorities in accordance with relevant laws, regulations, and administrative codes.
